m: Potatoes: oven to 220°C. Cut into small chunks, toss with oil, salt and rosemary, roast 35 minutes.
Bash the cutlets out to about 1cm thick between baking paper, leaving the bone on. Season both sides.
Mix the panko with half the parmesan. Dust the cutlets in flour, dip in beaten egg, then press firmly into the crumbs.
Shallow-fry in oil with a knob of butter over medium-high heat, 3 to 4 minutes a side, until deep golden and just cooked through. Rest on a rack so the bottom stays crisp.
Salad: rocket and halved tomatoes with lemon juice, oil and the rest of the parmesan shaved over.
Serve each cutlet with a big lemon wedge, the salad piled on top and potatoes alongside.
l: Slice the cutlet and pack with the salad. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep it crisp.
g: GF flour and crumbs, crumbed and fried first in fresh oil.
